completeness.why: All five provider handlers now only map their own data and call linkBankSyncAccount, which takes the upgrade-or-insert, transfer payee, initial sync, handleSyncResponse and sync-event sequence; the per-provider differences (file id, mask/official name, sync-event tables) are passed as explicit arguments.

interface.why: Parameters correspond to the real variations (sync source, bank key, insert fields, optional fileId, syncEventTables) with no speculative options and the preserved inconsistencies are explicit, though the loose institution union type and pulling the provider-specific bank lookup inside the helper slightly blur its contract.
